# Validate inputs
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2D numpy arrays")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain nonpositive log probabilities")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted losses
    losses_with = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    losses_call = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    losses_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)

    # Compute baseline and margin
    L_minus = np.minimum(losses_empty, losses_call)
    margin = L_minus - losses_with

    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
